### Railway passenger traffic sets record

China’s railway network recorded 3.71 billion passenger trips in the first nine months of 2026, up 4.8% year on year and a record for the period.

Trips by foreign passengers exceeded 19 million, an increase of 33.4%. Cross-border passenger traffic rose 37.8% on the China-Laos Railway and 11.8% on the Guangzhou-Shenzhen-Hong Kong high-speed rail link.
